title: Knowledge
subtitle: What the assistant remembers from your chats, the topics it organizes, and the files you upload all live here. Review, change or remove anything at any time.
loadFailed: Some content could not be loaded right now.

section.memoriesHint: The assistant uses these in future chats. Edit anything that is wrong, or forget what it should not keep.
section.topicsHint: Related memories are organized into topics automatically, so they are easy to read in one place.
section.filesHint: Uploaded files are organized automatically, and the assistant draws on them when it answers.

welcome.title: Your knowledge is empty for now
welcome.body: Preferences, agreements and important details you mention while chatting are collected here automatically.

chat.title: Remembered as you chat
chat.body: Tell the assistant about your habits, preferences or agreements and it will note them down.

topics.title: Organized into topics
topics.body: Related details are gathered into readable topic pages you can come back to.

files.title: Add your own material
files.body: Upload PDFs, Word documents and more for the assistant to draw on.

empty.memories: Nothing remembered yet. Mention a preference while chatting, or add one yourself.
empty.topics: Topics appear automatically once enough related details are remembered.
empty.searchBody: Try a different word, or ask the assistant directly in a chat.

topic.updatingHint: Something it relies on changed, so the assistant is reorganizing it.

file.dropTitle: Drop files here, or click to choose
file.dropHint: PDF (with selectable text), Word, TXT, Markdown, CSV and web pages, up to 10 MB each.
file.accepted: “{{name}}” was added and is being organized.
file.alreadyExists: “{{name}}” is already in your knowledge library. No duplicate was added.
file.unavailable: File uploads are not available for this account yet.

status.index_failed: Ready to read, search preparation failed

file.deleteBody: The file and everything organized from it are removed from your knowledge, and the assistant will no longer draw on it. Your chats are not affected. This cannot be undone.
file.deletedPending: Deleted “{{name}}”. Its original file is still being removed from storage and stays there until that finishes.
file.cleanupPending: Originals of deleted files still being removed from storage: {{count}}. This finishes on its own.

editor.createHint: Write down a preference, agreement or fact the assistant should keep in mind in future chats.
editor.editHint: Once saved, the assistant uses the new wording and related topics update automatically.
editor.label: Memory
editor.placeholder: For example: I'm allergic to peanuts; weekly reports go to Alex on Friday afternoons.
editor.created: Added. The assistant will take it into account from now on.
editor.saved: Saved. Related topics update in the background.
editor.conflict: This memory was just updated elsewhere. Your text is still here — copy it, close, reopen and save again.
editor.sensitive: For your safety, memories never keep passwords, ID or card numbers, phone numbers, email addresses or house numbers. Keep just the city or district, or remove the numbers and save again.

forget.title: Forget this memory?
forget.body: The assistant will stop using it and related topics will update automatically. Your chat history is not deleted.
forget.clearSources: Also clear the saved original wording ({{count}})
forget.clearSourcesHint: Other memories based on the same wording are forgotten too.
forget.done: Forgotten. Related data is cleared in the background.

detail.title: Memory details
detail.sourcesHint: The assistant remembered this from the following.
detail.sourceUnavailable: This wording is no longer available.
detail.unavailable: This content is no longer available.
detail.cleanupPending: The assistant no longer uses it, and related data is being cleared in the background.
detail.cleanupDone: All related data has been cleared.
detail.supersededSource: You corrected this later, so it no longer applies.

processing.pending: {{count}} conversation turns are being saved as memories…
processing.failedTitle: {{count}} things you said could not be saved
processing.failedHint: Usually a temporary network or service error; one retry normally fixes it. Ignore any you don't need.
processing.retried: Saving again; it will appear here shortly.
processing.dismissed: OK, no more reminders about this one.

manage.title: Manage
manage.autoSave: Remember what I say in chats
manage.autoSaveHint: The assistant keeps your preferences and details from chats.
manage.autoSaveOffHint: Off: nothing new is remembered from chats; existing memories are still used.
manage.autoSaveOn: On: what you say from now on will be remembered.
manage.autoSaveOff: Off: nothing new will be remembered from chats. Existing memories are still used, and you can forget or clear them anytime.
manage.clearScope: Every memory in “{{scope}}” will be forgotten and no longer used; related topics update on their own. Uploaded files and chats are not affected. This can't be undone.
manage.clearEverywhere: Every memory will be forgotten and no longer used; related topics update on their own. Uploaded files and chats are not affected. This can't be undone.
